description: Write emails, stories, blogs, messages, poems, essays, and more with AI!
changelog:
Version 3.1.0:
    - Fixed: nothing was being generated because the Gemini models used
      before (gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-1.5-pro) have been
      retired by Google. The add-on now asks Google which Gemini models are
      currently available, so renamed or retired models no longer break it
    - Added: free Pollinations AI backend that needs NO API key and is on
      by default, so the add-on works right after installing
    - Added: Gemini model box in settings (leave as "auto")
    - Changed: the free g4f backend (no key needed) is now on by default;
      it is used only if the g4f library is in the add-on's lib folder
    - Changed: backends are tried in this order: Gemini (if you add a free
      key), Pollinations, Hugging Face (optional token), g4f
    - Changed: Hugging Face now uses its current router address
    - Changed: Gemini key is sent in a request header instead of the web
      address, and replies can be much longer than before
    - Changed: error messages now reflect what the AI services actually
      reported (busy, bad key, no connection, and so on)
    - Changed: "Test AI Service Connection" now checks every backend

    Version 3.0:
    - Gemini and Hugging Face are now tried first for higher-quality, more
      reliable results
    - Fixed: generated text no longer permanently overwrites your clipboard -
      your previous clipboard contents are restored after every paste
    - Fixed: all shortcuts are now guarded against being triggered twice at
      once (e.g. pressing NVDA+Shift+H repeatedly while busy)
    - Fixed: language auto-detection now matches whole words only, so
      instructions like "German engineering" no longer force German output
    - Fixed: error messages are now short and screen-reader friendly instead
      of raw technical text
    - Added: NVDA+Shift+X to cancel a generation in progress
    - Added: NVDA+Shift+R to regenerate the last action
    - Added: NVDA+Shift+Y to browse recent generation history
    - Added: spoken preview of generated text (toggle in settings)
    - Added: periodic progress tone during slow requests so NVDA doesn't
      feel frozen
    - Added: provider indicator shown with translation/refine/history results
    - Added: tone and length can now be set inline in your instructions
      (e.g. "a short, friendly email about...") in addition to language
    - Added: editable per-content-type prompt templates in settings
    - Added: settings now disclose that API keys are stored locally in
      plain text

    Version 2.1.0:
    - Added Content Type selection (Email, Story, Blog, Message, Social, Poem, Essay, Report)
    - NVDA+Shift+G: Generate title for any topic
    - NVDA+Shift+H: Generate full content (stories, blogs, emails, etc.)
    - Auto language detection (write "in Marathi" for Marathi output)
    - Your Name field in settings (used for email signatures)
    - Uses g4f (free AI) with provider rotation
    - Works on any platform (WhatsApp, Telegram, Notepad, etc.)
